summary: Implementation and tests fully achieve the saved plan. git_auth.py adds bitbucket_askpass_script, bitbucket_agent_git_config_entries, and apply_bitbucket_agent_git_auth plus the sentinel-username URL constants and the worker-vs-agent divergence docstring, with the worker credential-helper path left byte-for-byte unchanged (locked by a new regression test). secret_mounts.py materializes the static 0o555 askpass script (no token value — only the injected env-var name), mounts it read-only at /run/awf/secrets/bb-askpass.sh, and wires GIT_ASKPASS/GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT/insteadOf into the agent env only when the BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN lease is actually injected. Tests cover all planned cases (a)-(f): rendered-compose leak-proof boundary, offline insteadOf rewrite for HTTPS + both SSH forms, no rewrite loop, token-only/email-only/non-bitbucket gating, exact GIT_CONFIG_COUNT accumulation layout, and read-only+executable static script. The only deviation is benign and semantically equivalent: apply_bitbucket_agent_git_auth omits the planned token_env_var parameter (the token name flows solely into the askpass script content), which reinforces the plan's intent that no token name ever enters env. AWF validation run vr_0ffd6b4535dc4ae0b209c784 succeeded (VALIDATION_OK); the broad full-pytest + 99% coverage gate is deferred to GitHub CI per the plan's Validation section and the awf-self profile strategy (final_gate: none, baseline_coverage: skip).
